zh: 图像右半部的大部分区域被一片黑色覆盖。
一条断续的浅色带沿中央向竖向和斜向延伸。
中部和下部的深色区域被小型浅色开口打断。
左边缘出现阶梯状且不规则的浅色缺口。
上部有孤立的三角形浅色间隙和残片。
阈值化图像没有保留连续可见的外轮廓。
en: A large black field occupies much of the right half of the image.
A broken pale band runs vertically and diagonally through the center.
Small pale openings interrupt the dark mass near the middle and bottom.
The left edge has a stepped, irregular pale cutout.
The upper area contains isolated triangular pale gaps and fragments.
The thresholded image does not preserve a continuous visible outline.
These observations describe visible marks only; no component, variant, or reading is assigned.
